blueprint.name: Mattermost demo
blueprint.summary: A low-cost, automatically configured Mattermost demo with a public HTTPS URL.
blueprint.description: Runs Mattermost Team Edition and PostgreSQL together on one small EC2 instance, fronted by CloudFront for a domain-free HTTPS address. Automatically creates an administrator and private demo team. Local data survives reboots; instance replacement and destroy remove the demo data. Intended for platform demonstrations, not production.

inputs.name: instance_type
inputs.description: Small x86 demo server. Choose t3.small where t3a is unavailable, or medium for more memory.

outputs.name: endpoint
outputs.description: Public HTTPS Mattermost URL, verified by the post hook and available to attach to the workload.

outputs.name: admin_credentials_parameter
outputs.description: SSM SecureString parameter name containing the initial administrator password. This output is a reference, never the credential value.

outputs.name: aws_region
outputs.description: AWS region containing the instance and administrator credential.

outputs.name: instance_id
outputs.description: EC2 instance ID for Systems Manager access and troubleshooting.

artifacts.name: terraform_root
artifacts.description: Terraform configuration and host bootstrap template for Mattermost.

artifacts.name: lifecycle_helpers
artifacts.description: Idempotent lifecycle entry points and dependency-free HTTPS readiness check.

dependencies.name: public_demo_policy
dependencies.reference: Effective workload policy permits public HTTPS ingress
dependencies.description: Deploy in an approved demo scope. Secure Foundation v1 public-ingress restrictions remain enforced and are incompatible with this blueprint.

dependencies.name: workload_endpoint_reporting
dependencies.reference: Runtime consumes the non-sensitive Terraform endpoint output
dependencies.description: Automatic workload linking needs the runtime endpoint-reporting update. The post hook prints the URL on older runtimes.

dependencies.name: aws_services
dependencies.reference: EC2, VPC, IAM, SSM Parameter Store, CloudFront
dependencies.description: Target-account provisioning role may create and destroy these resources. No existing VPC, DNS zone, certificate, SSH key, or paid Mattermost licence is required. Standard AWS commercial regions with t3/t3a and CloudFront origin-facing prefix lists are supported.

dependencies.name: bootstrap_downloads
dependencies.reference: Amazon Linux repositories, GitHub Docker Compose releases, Docker Hub
dependencies.description: Outbound internet access for initial package installation and pinned container downloads. Docker Hub anonymous pull limits can delay startup.

dependencies.name: mattermost
dependencies.description: Official Team Edition image pinned by digest in terraform/main.tf.

dependencies.name: postgresql
dependencies.description: Official PostgreSQL image pinned by digest in terraform/main.tf.
